scripts.translations:extract: ttag extract --output translations/default.pot --ignore 'src/ops/**' src && node scripts/public_pages_extract.js && node scripts/rust_translations_extract.js
scripts.translations:update: pnpm translations:extract && for po in translations/*.po translations/public/*.po ../core/translations/*.po; do [ -e "$po" ] || continue; msgmerge --quiet --update --backup=none "$po" "$(dirname "$po")/default.pot"; done && node scripts/rust_translations_compile.js
